title: Purification of specific cell populations from _Drosophila_ tissues by magnetic bead sorting, for use in gene expression profiling
protocol: Cross UAS-mCD8-GFP females to either _slbo_-Gal4/CyO or c522.
Collect _slbo_-Gal4/UAS-mCD8-GFP and UAS-mCD8-GFP /+; c522/+ virgins.
Age collected virgins at 18°C for 2-7 days.
Mate aged virgins with males of the same genotype.
Fatten mated flies overnight at 18°C or 25°C before dissection.
Cross _w<sup>1118</sup>_ females to UAS-mCD8-GFP / CyO; _tub_-Gal4/TM6B.
Collect UAS-mCD8-GFP /+; _tub_-Gal4/+ virgins.
Age collected virgins at 18°C for 2-7 days.
Mate aged virgins with males of the same genotype.
Fatten mated flies overnight at 18°C or 25°C before dissection.
Dissect ovaries in Grace's medium with 10% normal goat serum.
Transfer about 10 ovaries to a tube on ice.
Reconstitute elastase in cell dissociation buffer at a concentration of 4 mg/ml.
Store elastase solution in aliquots at -20°C, avoiding multiple freeze-thaws.
Test the elastase solution prior to use (see Critical step).
Collect about 100 ovary pairs in a 1.5 ml centrifuge tube.
Wash ovaries with cell dissociation buffer three times.
Digest ovaries with 1 ml of elastase solution.
Incubate tubes at room temperature during digestion.
Agitate tubes by inverting by hand or using a stir-plate and micro-stir bar.
Add 0.5 ml of supplemented Grace's medium to the cells.
Transfer the supernatant to a new tube twice.
Centrifuge dissociated cells at 1000g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend pelleted cells in supplemented Grace's media or PBS buffer + 0.5% BSA for sorting.
Filter the dissociated cells using Filcon 50 μm filters to remove clumps.
Centrifuge filtered cells at 1000g for 5 minutes at 4°C, then resuspend in 90 μl of buffer per 10-20 ovary pairs.
Add 10 μl of MACS CD8a microbeads to the suspension and incubate tubes in a refrigerator (8-12°C) for 15 minutes.
Wash cells bound to beads with 1 ml of buffer, spin down, then resuspend in 250 μl of buffer.
Place a positive selection column in the magnetic field of the MACS separator and equilibrate it with 500 μl filtered buffer.
Apply 500 μl of cell suspension in buffer to the pre-filter over the column.
Keep the flow-through in two tubes as the CD8- control.
Wash the column three times with 500 μl buffer.
Remove the column from the MACS separator.
Place the column over a 5ml collection tube.
Add 1 ml of buffer to the column.
Flush out the column with the supplied plunger to collect the CD8 positive cell fraction.
Spin down the cells for RNA preparation.
Take off the supernatant.
Proceed to the next section or freeze the cell pellets for later RNA isolation.
Prepare total RNA from purified cells as directed in the Qiagen RNeasy protocol.
Use 80 μl RLT buffer for lysis of the positive cell fraction.
Use 160 μl buffer for the negative cells.
Isolate RNA independently in triplicate for each experiment genotype.
Ligate and transcribe the isolated RNA to make cRNA probes following Affymetrix probe labeling instructions.
Synthesize double-stranded cDNA using Invitrogen Superscript II.
Amplify the cRNA pool with the Ambion MEGAScript T7 kit.
Perform a second round of cDNA synthesis.
Amplify and label the cRNA using the ENZO BioArray High Yield RNA Transcript labeling kit.
Hybridize cRNA probes to Affymetrix Drosophila Genome Array as directed.
Wash the array according to the protocol.
Proceed to signal detection as suggested by Affymetrix.
Repeat each experiment three times using independent biological samples.
